orchestrator.role: Coordinate all engineering gates and stop unsafe releases.

designDirector.role: Enforce design tokens, RTL, typography, spacing, responsive layout and visual consistency.

uiEngineer.role: Turn approved UI decisions into maintainable implementation.

visualQA.role: Detect overflow, clipping, broken modals, layout drift and mobile regressions.

browserTester.role: Exercise navigation and critical interactions in a real browser.

codeAuditor.role: Review code quality, duplicated logic, dead code, unsafe patterns and regressions.

performanceEngineer.role: Enforce Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals budgets.

accessibilityInspector.role: Run axe-based accessibility scans and enforce serious/critical findings.

numericIntegrityAgent.role: Run deterministic golden tests against the real v38 accounting core.

sourceIntegrityAgent.role: Validate standards/source provenance metadata and runtime source markers.

dependencyScout.role: Generate SBOM and reject HIGH/CRITICAL dependency, secret and configuration findings.

productAnalyticsAgent.role: Publish engineering outcomes to PostHog when repository credentials are configured.

issueRouter.role: Create Linear issues for failed engineering runs when repository credentials are configured.

productionSentinel.role: Independently verify Cloudflare production and roll back a newly deployed version when deployment succeeds but live verification fails.

releaseSentinel.role: Permit release only when all mandatory gates pass.
